mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Read the uploaded government cloud migration RFP (likely PDF or Word). Convert it into a structured format (JSON) capturing sections, headings, tables, and key text blocks. Store the parsed data for downstream tasks.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: Structured JSON representation of the entire RFP document with section identifiers and raw text content.

units.description: Analyze the parsed RFP JSON to identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). Produce a list of criteria with unique identifiers and brief descriptions.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: Table of mandatory compliance criteria (ID, description, source location in RFP).

units.description: Using the compliance criteria and typical cloud migration labor roles (e.g., architect, engineer, project manager), create a tiered pricing model (e.g., Tier A: high‑skill, Tier B: mid‑skill, Tier C: junior). Calculate hourly rates, estimated effort per criterion, and total cost per tier.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: Pricing matrix with tiers, roles, hourly rates, effort estimates, and aggregated costs for each compliance item.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a formal executive proposal that includes: an executive summary, solution overview, compliance traceability matrix linking each RFP criterion to the proposed solution and pricing tier, key milestones, risk mitigation plan, and contact information. Ensure all mandatory criteria are referenced and justified.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2, t3]
units.output_contract: Complete proposal document (Markdown or Word‑style text) ready for submission, including a compliance traceability table.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP that includes mandatory technical compliance criteria extraction, multi‑tier labor pricing modeling, and a compliance traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The request requires ingesting an uploaded document, extracting structured requirements, performing quantitative modeling of labor costs, and synthesizing a formal proposal with traceability. This maps to a four‑phase pipeline: ingestion & parsing, requirement extraction, cost modeling, and final proposal generation.
